description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Change the enforced monthly limit only to the amount the owner explicitly requested. Show current usage and prices first. The limit includes the base plan and usage overages; it cannot be set below already committed charges. Both actions stop paid usage; ask also leaves a note asking the owner to raise the limit. Never raise a limit to bypass a paused call on your own.
name: receptionist_limits
title: Set my monthly spending limit
